# Business Identity
Entity Type: General Contractor / Home & Commercial Building Construction Firm
Core Competencies: Turnkey Residential House Construction, Structural RCC Civil Engineering, Load-Bearing Brick Masonry, Waterproof Formwork Shuttering, MEP Infrastructure (Concealed Electrical & Sanitary Plumbing), Stone & Vitrified Tiling, Interior Finishing & POP False Ceilings.
Verified Business Source: Official client construction quotation documents and site bills of quantities (BOQ).

# Primary Services
1. Residential Turnkey Construction (Complete from foundation excavation to key handover under single-point engineering responsibility)
2. Building Construction & Civil Works (Commercial open-span structures, structural framing, multi-floor residential structures)

# Construction Services
1. Brick Works & Masonry (First-class Awwal red clay bricks; 9-inch exterior walls in 6:1 cement mortar; 4.5-inch interior partition walls in 5:1 cement mortar; 8:5:1 PCC bed concrete)
2. RCC Works (Engineered 3:2:1 concrete mix with 20+10mm or 30+10mm aggregates; Fe 550D high-ductility TMT rebars; commercial-grade UltraTech Weather Plus or ACC Gold cement)
3. Shuttering Works (Waterproof film-faced plywood formwork supported by heavy balli and patra props for 8 to 12 feet clear ceiling heights)
4. Plastering Works (External 15mm double-coat rough plaster in 6:1 ratio; Internal 10mm fine sponge plaster in 6:1 ratio; Ceiling 7mm plaster in 6:1 ratio)
5. Electrical Works (Heavy PVC roof conduits at approx. ₹70-75/m; Medium PVC wall conduits at approx. ₹45-50/m; FRLS fire-retardant multi-strand copper wiring; modular switch plates)
6. Plumbing Works (Astral / Supreme PVC 5" and 4" drainage pipes at 5-6 kg pressure; UPVC & CPVC concealed water lines; Jaquar / Cera sanitaryware suites; Sintex PU water storage tanks)
7. Flooring Works / Stone & Tiling (2x2 and 2x4 vitrified floor tiles; polished natural marble in family/dining areas; jet-black granite kitchen counter with edge molding; granite/marble staircase steps with full molding)
8. Wood and MS Works (Hardwood door frames; flush doors with Godrej mortise locks; Prominence UPVC glazed windows with clear float glass; heavy MS box main entrance gate)
9. Railing Works (Grade 204 / 304 stainless steel staircase railing; mild steel box and flat section balcony safety railing)
10. POP / Painting Works (Decorative POP false ceiling with cornices and moldings in premium tier; double-coat white cement putty; Asian Paints / Nerolac interior washable emulsion; synthetic enamel on steel)

# Turnkey Packages
Quotation rates specified in official documents (calculated per square foot of measured built-up slab area + 18% GST):
- Residential Hall Turnkey Quotation: ₹1,500 / SQFT + 18% GST
  Scope: Heavy RCC 3:2:1 frame, first-class Awwal brickwork, 2x2 vitrified tiles (up to ₹35-40/sqft), Cera sanitaryware, Prominence UPVC windows, MS entrance gate, 204 SS stair railing, Asian Paints/Nerolac emulsion. POP false ceiling is excluded.
- Standard Residential Building Turnkey Quotation: ₹1,850 / SQFT + 18% GST
  Scope: Complete multi-floor residential build, RCC 3:2:1 frame, Fe 550D TMT rebar, UltraTech/ACC cement, 2x2/2x4 vitrified tiles (up to ₹40-60/sqft), polished natural marble in family/dining room (up to ₹80-100/sqft), Jaquar wall-hung commode suite (up to ₹5,500-6,500), Shakuntalam/Black Cherry flush doors with Godrej locks, Prominence UPVC sliding windows (up to ₹450-550/sqft), and 500L Sintex PU tank.
- Premium Residential Building Turnkey Quotation: ₹2,250 / SQFT + 18% GST
  Scope: Includes POP decorative false ceiling, cornices, and moldings (valued up to ₹90-125/sqft), luxury Jaquar wall-hung commode suite (up to ₹7,000-10,000), large format 2x4 glazed vitrified tiles (up to ₹60-80/sqft), natural polished marble (up to ₹100-120/sqft), Century Ply/Advance flush doors with Godrej brass-finish handles, 1,000L Sintex PU-insulated tank, and premium washable emulsion.
Note on Single Floor Construction: If construction is limited to a single ground floor only, a 25% extra surcharge applies to cover the foundational substructure.
Quotation Validity: Agreed rates remain valid for 1 year or within the contract timeline; a 10% rate escalation surcharge applies if delayed beyond 1 year.

# Materials
- Cement: Commercial-grade OPC/PPC ('Not for Sale' industrial packaging)
- Concrete Mix Ratio: 3:2:1 (3 parts aggregates 20+10mm or 30+10mm, 2 parts coarse sand, 1 part cement)
- Foundation PCC: Ratio 8:5:1 (8 parts aggregates 20mm & 40mm, 5 parts sand, 1 part cement)
- Masonry Sand: Screened medium / super medium red riverbed sand (morang)
- Bricks: First-class kiln-burned Awwal red clay bricks with sharp geometric edges
- Steel: Fe 550D grade high-ductility TMT rebars (20mm/M-20 slab specification)
- Shuttering: Waterproof film-faced plywood with heavy wooden balli and steel patra supports
- Electrical Conduits: Heavy PVC (roof) and medium PVC (walls)
- Wiring: Multi-strand FRLS (Fire Retardant Low Smoke) electrolytic copper wire
- Piping: PVC / SWR drainage pipes (5" & 4" with 5-6 kg pressure) and concealed CPVC / UPVC water lines
- Water Storage: PU-insulated multi-layer overhead water tanks (500 Litre / 1,000 Litre)
- Stone & Slabs: 2x2 and 2x4 vitrified floor tiles, natural polished marble, and jet-black granite slabs

# Brand References
Brand names specified in the quotation (or equivalent standard):
- Cement: UltraTech Weather Plus or ACC Gold ('Not for Sale' grade) specified in quotation
- Steel Rebar (TMT): Tata, Jindal, Kamdhenu, Captain or equivalent
- Electrical Wires & Switches: RR Kabel (FRLS), Havells, Polycab, Anchor Roma or equivalent
- Plumbing Pipes & Fittings: Astral, Supreme or equivalent
- Sanitaryware & CP Fittings: Jaquar, Cera, Kohler or equivalent
- Floor & Wall Tiles: Kajaria, Vermora or equivalent
- Doors & Joinery: Century Ply, Advance, Shakuntalam, Black Cherry, Godrej hardware or equivalent
- Windows: Prominence UPVC or equivalent with 5-6mm clear float glass
- Water Tanks: Sintex PU or equivalent
- Paint & Finishes: Asian Paints, Nerolac or equivalent

# Measurement Rules
Area measurement rules strictly follow official construction quotation terms:
- Slab Area — 100% (Calculated at 100% of clear horizontal built-up roof slab dimensions)
- Double Slab Area / Do Chhatti — 50% (Calculated at 50% rate of measured horizontal area)
- Stair Area — 150% (Calculated at 150% rate due to specialized formwork, steel reinforcement cage, and vertical step risers)

# Payment Structure
7-stage milestone payment schedule strictly tied to verified civil engineering progress:
- Stage 1: 20% on booking and contract signing
- Stage 2: 10% on plinth level completion (footings, tie-beams, plinth masonry)
- Stage 3: 15% on column casting till beam bottom for respective floor
- Stage 4: 10% on brick masonry / retaining walls for respective floor
- Stage 5: 20% on RCC roof slab casting (dhalai)
- Stage 6: 5% on plaster work completion (internal fine & external rough)
- Stage 7: 20% on final finishing (tiling, sanitaryware, electrical fixtures, painting) and key handover
Total: 100%

# Exclusions
Items and scopes excluded from the turnkey quotation rate (billed separately or provided by property owner):
- External compound boundary wall and decorative pillar caps (quoted on running foot basis)
- Deep borewell drilling and submersible pump installation
- Garden and landscaping development (lawn grass, plantation, garden piping)
- Special elevation features (cantilever pergolas, louvers, exterior wooden ACP canopies)
- Decorative lighting fixtures, tube lights, ceiling fans, chandeliers, and exhaust fans
- Air conditioning (AC) units and copper refrigerant piping
- Loose furniture, wardrobes, beds, and modular kitchen wooden cabinetry
- Elevator / lift machinery and shaft operating equipment
- Main electrical power cable from utility street pole to site meter board
- Temporary electricity and water consumption during the construction phase (provided by property owner)
- Earth / soil filling for plinth backfill (provided by property owner)
